shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/blocks/Header.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- peer npm trees ---\\n'; node -e \"for(const p of ['@diplodoc/transform']) {try{console.log(p,require(p+'/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log(p,'absent')}}\" ; printf '\\n--- page constructor block registry ---\\n'; rg -n \"header-block|banner-block|card-layout-block|basic-card\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/blocks 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'export.*PageContent|interface PageContent|type PageContent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm | head -60; printf '\\n--- package exports ---\\n'; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,2))\""
